method: black-box sequences of 1-3 random ops over 3 entry points; nanopb stream/decode/encode stubbed (returns 1/0/0x100, random errmsg, bytes_written incl. > max), 11 PB_Rx* handlers (random returns) and 11 PB_TxEncode* handlers observed, BLE tx, event-loop delayed push/remove, fault handler; command ids across all 18 cases incl. unknown/out-of-range, NULL frame, error-code payloads; 600 tests + 60 per mutant (bias toward mutated entry)
observed: all callee args (payloads by content), return values, logs, fault records, encoded message hash; tx message (0xd0) and tx buffer (0x100) after every op
test_notes: first run 517/600: diffs only when APP_PbTxEncodeErrorCode was called directly with uint8 parameters holding values >0xff (stock IAR re-extends magic in the callee, GCC relies on the AAPCS caller extension). Test now passes in-range uint8 values; all firmware callers pass uint8 values.
